model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different relevance criteria. The horizontal axis displays the categories for “Criterion”, listing “Veracity Explanation”, “Filters”, “Overall Summary”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Relevance Explanation”, “FC Summary”, and “Relevant FCs” in that order from bottom to top; these categories are not explicitly sorted. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks every 2 units. Each criterion is represented by a single, solid-colored bar. “Veracity Explanation” and “Filters” each have a bar length of 1, corresponding to a value of 1 on the vertical axis. “Overall Summary” and “Clarity and Simplicity” both have a bar length of 2. “Relevance Explanation” is represented by a bar of length 3, “FC Summary” by a bar of length 5, and the tallest bar, representing “Relevant FCs”, has a length of 6. All bars are colored in shades of teal and green, with darker shades generally corresponding to larger values, but no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
